text:
Sana (Head of Reliability): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — posting the RCA and a short set of action items for the 3/2 outage. Please review and acknowledge. RCA: https://redwood.internal/rcas/2024-03-02-outage

Jules (SRE): TL;DR: cascade triggered by autoscaler overspin combined with a rollout bug in the model-restart controller. Full timeline + logs in the RCA.

Marco (VP Eng): Thanks Sana. Two quick Qs: 1) Does this change the Dedicated roadmap? 2) Any customer-facing impact we should call out? @Priya can you weigh in?

Priya (Infra): Short answer: no Dedicated feature delays. We'll prioritize the critical autoscaler fixes; the planned capacity-controls feature gets bumped to Q2. Planning doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/infra/autoscaler-plan

Leo (Backend): Can someone paste the exact alert defs that fired? Trying to map to our service metrics.

Jules (SRE): Paste of key alert and grep cmd —
```
ALERT: high_instance_spinup_rate
IF rate(autoscaler.spinups[5m]) > 10
FOR: 5m
```
Pull logs: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://logs.redwood/internal?query=spinup`

Jules (SRE): Action items (owner — ETA):
- A1: Lock autoscaler rollouts to canary-by-region (owner: Jules, ETA: 2024-03-16)
- A2: Add hysteresis + debounce to spinup alerts (owner: Leo, ETA: 2024-03-09)
- A3: Backfill missing KV cache telemetry (owner: Priya, ETA: 2024-03-12)
- A4: Run targeted chaos test for model restart path (owner: Marco, ETA: 2024-03-20)

Ava (CEO): Appreciated. Ops/Support: please prep a short customer note for EOD tomorrow outlining remediation and steps we're taking. Keep it high level.

Sana (Head of Reliability): I'll stand up a weekly sync to track these items. If you have an action, add it to the 'reliability-ongoing' board and ping me. React with :thumbsup: when you've acknowledged your item.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: autoscaler-hysteresis v2 -> prod at 2024-03-06T14:10Z :rocket:

Leo (Backend): ack — A2 added to board and assigned to me. :white_check_mark:

Priya (Infra): Starting KV telemetry backfill Monday; will post daily progress in #eng-infra.

Marco (VP Eng): We'll include a short note in the next roadmap sync and surface any customer-facing changes. Thanks all.

Sana (Head of Reliability): Closing this thread for now — interim updates will be shared in #incidents. Final closure note will go out when all items are complete.
